property_summary: When a newAddressProposal is created with a non-zero proposed address, then later another newAddressProposal of the same type is created and the first is finalised, after cancelProposal(1,2) the reference contract retains the original address at mapPID_address[1] while the buggy contract zeroes it.
change_summary: Replace the assignment of mapPID_address with a no-op by setting it to address(0) instead of the proposed address.
